We need to determine the appropriate charge(s) for the given facts.

Facts: The defendant applied for multiple credit cards from several banks, had no ability to repay, used them to overdraw and cash withdraw, changed address and phone without notifying banks, after multiple collection attempts, still didn't repay. Total overdraft amount 62,281.95 RMB across several banks. He was caught, confessed, repaid all principal and interest for Shanghai Bank card, and with family helped return other illegal gains.
